# DOI Badge Template

After you get the DOI from Zenodo, replace `XXXXXXX` with the actual record number in this badge:

```markdown
[![DOI](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.5281/zenodo.XXXXXXX.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.XXXXXXX)
```

Then add it to the top of `README.md`, right after the title.

Example rendering:
[![DOI](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.5281/zenodo.XXXXXXX.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.XXXXXXX)

## Alternative shields.io badge

If you prefer a custom-styled badge:

```markdown
[![DOI](https://img.shields.io/badge/DOI-10.5281%2Fzenodo.XXXXXXX-blue.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.XXXXXXX)
```

Both work. The first is Zenodo's official style.
